title: An Act to Further Protect Victims from Contact Prohibited by Probation Conditions

summary.text: This bill allows a court to revoke the probation of an individual who contacts a victim in violation of probation conditions not just if the contact is with a victim of the crime for which the individual is currently serving an unsuspended portion of a split sentence, as allowed under current law, but also if the contact is with a victim of another crime for which the individual received either a concurrent or consecutive sentence related to the current sentence.
